features.name: ob__total_depth_bid
features.description: Sum of visible bid size across tracked depth levels for the current snapshot.

features.name: ob__total_depth_ask
features.description: Sum of visible ask size across tracked depth levels for the current snapshot.

features.name: ob__top_level_size_bid
features.description: Displayed bid size at the best bid price level.

features.name: ob__top_level_size_ask
features.description: Displayed ask size at the best ask price level.

features.name: ob__imbalance
features.description: Normalized depth imbalance (bid minus ask) divided by total depth.

features.name: ob__signed_book_pressure
features.description: Signed pressure proxy combining imbalance and spread to reflect directional liquidity.

features.name: ob__imbalance_spread_adj
features.description: Imbalance adjusted by relative bid-ask spread to penalize wide markets.

features.name: ob__depth_imbalance_by_distance
features.description: Distance-weighted depth imbalance favoring near-touch liquidity.

features.name: ob__level_decay_rate
features.description: Rate at which size decays across successive depth levels.

features.name: ob__orderbook_gap
features.description: Absolute price gap between best ask and best bid (spread).

features.name: ob__bid_slope
features.description: Gradient of bid depth with respect to price levels, indicating bid book steepness.

features.name: ob__ask_slope
features.description: Gradient of ask depth with respect to price levels, indicating ask book steepness.

features.name: ob__curvature
features.description: Second-order shape measure capturing concavity of the aggregated book.

features.name: ob__depth_skew
features.description: Relative skewness of depth distribution between bid and ask sides.

features.name: ob__book_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of normalized depth across tracked levels (0 if no depth).

features.name: ob__cancellation_rate
features.description: Rate of cancellations relative to visible queue size at top levels.

features.name: ob__new_order_rate
features.description: Rate of new limit orders entering the book relative to existing depth.

features.name: ob__top_of_book_turnover
features.description: Proportion of top-of-book size replaced since previous snapshot.

features.name: ob__queue_position_change_bid
features.description: Change in effective queue position on the bid side relative to previous snapshot.

features.name: ob__queue_position_change_ask
features.description: Change in effective queue position on the ask side relative to previous snapshot.

features.name: ob__queue_resilience
features.description: Speed at which top-of-book depth replenishes after depletion.

features.name: ob__queue_imbalance_momentum
features.description: Directional change in queue imbalance between current and previous snapshot.

features.name: ob__hidden_liquidity_indicator
features.description: Flag indicating inferred presence of hidden liquidity based on anomalous fills.

features.name: ob__hidden_to_visible_ratio
features.description: Ratio of inferred hidden size to displayed size at the touch.

features.name: ob__liquidity_void_flag
features.description: Flag set when adjacent depth levels exhibit an abnormally large price gap.

features.name: ob__bid_dominance_factor
features.description: Relative dominance of bid-side liquidity versus ask-side across tracked levels.

features.name: ob__microstructure_pressure_velocity
features.description: First-difference of signed book pressure capturing its instantaneous change.

features.name: ob__depth_elasticity
features.description: Sensitivity of mid-price to marginal depth changes around the touch.
